meta.description: Dependency graph of the Mournival monorepo. Nodes are packages and source modules; edges are import relationships. Groups: workspace=top-level npm workspace packages, shared=shared library modules, client=React client modules, server=server modules, external=third-party npm packages, test=test files.

nodes.label: mournival (root)
nodes.description: Root npm workspace. Scripts: dev (concurrently), build, typecheck, test, coverage.

nodes.label: @mournival/shared
nodes.description: Pure TypeScript game logic library. No runtime dependencies — all devDeps. Consumed by both client and server.

nodes.label: @mournival/client
nodes.description: React + Vite SPA. Depends on @mournival/shared, react, react-dom, socket.io-client, zustand.

nodes.label: @mournival/server
nodes.description: Node.js server. Depends on @mournival/shared, express, socket.io, cors.

nodes.label: types.ts
nodes.description: All TypeScript interfaces and enums: Card, Player, GameState, HandType, ConsumableCard, JokerDefinition, MonsterDefinition, event maps, etc. No imports — pure declarations.

nodes.label: cards.ts
nodes.description: Deck creation, shuffling, dealing. Exports: createDeck, shuffleDeck, dealCards, RANK_ORDER, RANK_CHIP_VALUE, SUIT_SYMBOL, isFaceCard.

nodes.label: hands.ts
nodes.description: Hand evaluation (13 hand types, wild card greedy algorithm). Exports: evaluateHand, HAND_LABEL, HAND_RANK, HandEvaluation.

nodes.label: scoring.ts
nodes.description: Chips × Mult damage calculation. Applies joker effects, card enhancements, class bonuses, Mournival team combo. Exports: scoreHand.

nodes.label: classes.ts
nodes.description: Class definitions (Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Cleric, Ranger). Exports: CLASS_DEFINITIONS, applyClassToPlayer.

nodes.label: monsters.ts
nodes.description: Monster definitions and room selection. Exports: getMonsterForRoom, MONSTER_DEFINITIONS.

nodes.label: jokers.ts
nodes.description: Joker card definitions and shop generation. Exports: JOKER_DEFINITIONS, getShopJokers.

nodes.label: consumables.ts
nodes.description: Arcana (16 effects) and Celestial Stone (13 hand types) consumable definitions, shop generation, and effect application. Exports: makeArcana, makeCelestial, getShopConsumables, applyConsumableEffect, HAND_LEVEL_BONUS.

nodes.label: gameLogic.ts
nodes.description: Core state machine: createGameState, initPlayer, selectCards, playHands, discardCards, advanceAfterResult, buyJoker, buyConsumable, useConsumable, startCombat, endShop.

nodes.label: index.ts
nodes.description: Barrel file — re-exports everything from all shared modules.

nodes.label: __tests__/helpers.ts
nodes.description: Shared test utilities: card(), makePlayer(), makeCombatState().

nodes.label: __tests__/cards.test.ts
nodes.description: Tests for cards.ts: deck size, shuffling, dealing.

nodes.label: __tests__/hands.test.ts
nodes.description: Tests for hands.ts: all 13 hand types, wild cards.

nodes.label: __tests__/scoring.test.ts
nodes.description: Tests for scoring.ts: chip/mult math, joker effects, enhancements, Mournival combo.

nodes.label: __tests__/gameLogic.test.ts
nodes.description: Tests for gameLogic.ts: game lifecycle, play/discard, shop, death.

nodes.label: __tests__/consumables.test.ts
nodes.description: Tests for consumables.ts: all arcana effects, celestial stones, shop generation.

nodes.label: main.tsx
nodes.description: React entry point. Mounts App into DOM, imports index.css.

nodes.label: App.tsx
nodes.description: Top-level router component. Renders Lobby → ClassSelect → GameBoard or Shop based on game phase.

nodes.label: socket.ts
nodes.description: Singleton socket.io-client instance typed with ClientToServerEvents / ServerToClientEvents.

nodes.label: store/gameStore.ts
nodes.description: Zustand store. Holds GameState, myPlayerId, activeConsumableId. Wires socket events to state updates and emits actions.

nodes.label: index.css
nodes.description: Full design system: midnight teal/arcane palette, layout (.board, .board-body, .board-left, .board-center, .board-right), card styles, joker chips, score panel, consumables.

nodes.label: GameBoard.tsx
nodes.description: Root game layout: JokerBar (top) + board-body with left sidebar (monster, players, score), center (HandArea), right (GameLog).

nodes.label: HandArea.tsx
nodes.description: Card hand display, play/discard buttons, consumable targeting mode.

nodes.label: CardComponent.tsx
nodes.description: Single playing card rendering with suit symbol, rank, enhancement badge, selection/disabled states.

nodes.label: ConsumableTray.tsx
nodes.description: Row of consumable cards. Click activates targeting mode via gameStore.

nodes.label: JokerBar.tsx
nodes.description: Top strip showing local player's held jokers as chips with rarity color coding.

nodes.label: ScorePanel.tsx
nodes.description: Live scoring preview in left sidebar. Calls evaluateHand + scoreHand client-side.

nodes.label: MonsterDisplay.tsx
nodes.description: Monster HP bar, floor/room indicator, weakness display.

nodes.label: PlayerStatusPanel.tsx
nodes.description: Per-player status card: class, HP, hands/discards remaining, status badge.

nodes.label: GameLog.tsx
nodes.description: Scrolling game log with auto-scroll to bottom.

nodes.label: RoundResultOverlay.tsx
nodes.description: Modal overlay shown after each round: damage dealt, winner, continue button.

nodes.label: Lobby.tsx
nodes.description: Room creation/join UI. Emits createRoom/joinRoom socket events.

nodes.label: ClassSelect.tsx
nodes.description: Class selection screen shown after joining. Emits selectClass event.

nodes.label: Shop.tsx
nodes.description: Shop phase UI: joker and consumable purchasing, hand level display, end shop button.

nodes.label: server/index.ts
nodes.description: Express + socket.io server. Handles all socket events: createRoom, joinRoom, selectClass, selectCards, playHand, discard, buyJoker, buyConsumable, useConsumable, endShop, disconnect.

nodes.label: server/rooms.ts
nodes.description: In-memory room registry. Manages room creation, player joining, class confirmation, game start.

nodes.label: react
nodes.description: React 18 — UI component library.

nodes.label: react-dom
nodes.description: React DOM renderer.

nodes.label: socket.io-client
nodes.description: WebSocket client library (v4).

nodes.label: zustand
nodes.description: Lightweight React state management.

nodes.label: socket.io
nodes.description: WebSocket server library (v4).

nodes.label: express
nodes.description: HTTP server framework.

nodes.label: cors
nodes.description: CORS middleware for express.

nodes.label: vitest
nodes.description: Test runner (v2) with @vitest/coverage-v8. 80% threshold enforced.

nodes.label: vite
nodes.description: Build tool and dev server for the client.

nodes.label: concurrently
nodes.description: Runs server and client dev processes in parallel from root.
